meta.name: explore-code
meta.description: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让研究代码里的模型改动变成可回溯、可回滚的探索实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是深度学习研究者,总想在代码里尝试改模型,又怕改坏回不去。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do experimental edits to DL research code and need every change recoverable.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你授权时，于隔离分支或工作区做有边界的探索性代码改动，如移植模块、改造骨干、加入 LoRA/adapter、替换网络头。它倾向源码级复制和最小修改，并将变更原因、回滚方式及“这是候选非定论”的记录写进 explore_outputs/。
howto.when: 当研究人员明确授权在隔离分支或工作区上做探索性代码修改，且任务是移植模块、改造骨干、插入 LoRA/adapter 等低风险源码级改动时触发。

say.text: 我授权在新分支上把 ResNet 骨干换成 ViT，做出带回滚步骤的候选实现。
say.note: 将生成探索性改动并记录到 explore_outputs。

say.text: 在隔离 worktree 里给模型加一层 LoRA，但不要改动可信基线。
say.note: Claude 会单独记录改动，基线不受影响。

say.text: 这次低风险迁移：替换 attention 模块前先写清回滚方案。
say.note: 先会输出变更计划与回滚说明。

howto.what_en: When authorized, Claude makes bounded exploratory edits on an isolated branch/worktree: transplanting modules, adapting backbones, adding LoRA/adapters, or replacing heads. It prefers source-anchored minimal changes and writes reasons, rollback steps, and candidate status into explore_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory code changes on an isolated branch/worktree for tasks such as module transplant, backbone adaptation, LoRA/adapter insertion, or low-risk combination.

say_en.text: Authorize new branch: replace ResNet backbone with ViT, keep rollback notes.
say_en.note: Will produce a recorded candidate change.

say_en.text: In a separate worktree, add LoRA while keeping the baseline unchanged.
say_en.note: Changes are recorded separately, baseline stays intact.

say_en.text: Before swapping the attention module, write rollback steps for the migration.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a change plan with rollback details first.
